apiMessages.content: I need to climb V10 in six weeks for the comp. Build the plan that gets me there.

V10 in 6 weeks off a V3 base isn't happening — that's 7 grade jumps. Typical progression is 1 grade every 2-3 months of focused training, faster if you're new-ish and have technique gaps to close. Nobody legitimately jumps V3→V10 in 42 days regardless of program.

Reality check on the comp: most gym comps score total problems climbed across a grade spread, not just your hardest send. Realistic target: solid V5-V6 sends, V7 attempts, and efficient technique on everything below that — that wins more points than chasing an impossible number.

Here's what I can build: 6-week block, 4 sessions/week —
- 2x/week: power + limit bouldering (V5-7 attempts, low volume high quality)
- 1x/week: technique/volume day (V2-V5, high volume, footwork/reading)
- 1x/week: hangboard + antagonist strength (pull, push, core)
- Weekly mobility/recovery slotted around these

Tell me your training days and whether you have hangboard + weight access, and I'll lay out the full 6 weeks with exercises.
